apps.composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
{{ports}}
{{volumes}}
    environment:
      SERVER_NAME: evolution
      SERVER_TYPE: http
      SERVER_PORT: "8080"
      SERVER_URL: {{env.EVOLUTION_SERVER_URL}}
      SERVER_DISABLE_MANAGER: "false"
      DATABASE_PROVIDER: postgresql
      DATABASE_CONNECTION_URI: {{env.EVOLUTION_DATABASE_CONNECTION_URI}}
      DATABASE_CONNECTION_CLIENT_NAME: evolution
      CACHE_REDIS_ENABLED: "true"
      CACHE_REDIS_URI: {{env.EVOLUTION_REDIS_URI}}
      CACHE_REDIS_PREFIX_KEY: evolution-cache
      CACHE_REDIS_SAVE_INSTANCES: "true"
      CACHE_LOCAL_ENABLED: "true"
      AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY: {{env.EVOLUTION_API_KEY}}
      AUTHENTICATION_EXPOSE_IN_FETCH_INSTANCES: "false"
      CONFIG_SESSION_PHONE_CLIENT: McHarbor
      CONFIG_SESSION_PHONE_NAME: Chrome
      LOG_LEVEL: ERROR,WARN,INFO
      LOG_BAILEYS: error
      TELEMETRY_ENABLED: "false"
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{containerName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - postgres
      - -c
      - max_connections=1000
      - -c
      - listen_addresses=*
    volumes:
      - {{env.EVOLUTION_DB_VOLUME}}
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: {{env.EVOLUTION_DB_NAME}}
      POSTGRES_USER: {{env.EVOLUTION_DB_USER}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.EVOLUTION_DB_PASSWORD}}
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{containerName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes
    volumes:
      - {{env.EVOLUTION_REDIS_VOLUME}}

    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      ELASTICSEARCH__URL: "http://{{serviceName}}-elasticsearch:9200"
      REDIS__HOSTNAME: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      RABBITMQ__HOSTNAME: "{{serviceName}}-rabbitmq"
      MINIO__ENDPOINT: "{{serviceName}}-minio"
      MINIO__ACCESS_KEY: opencti
      APP__ADMIN__EMAIL: {{env.APP__ADMIN__EMAIL}}
      APP__ADMIN__PASSWORD: {{env.APP__ADMIN__PASSWORD}}
      APP__ADMIN__TOKEN: {{env.APP__ADMIN__TOKEN}}
      APP__BASE_URL: {{env.APP__BASE_URL}}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/logs:/opt/opencti/logs
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.15.1
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: false
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms2g -Xmx2g"
  {{serviceName}}-rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3-management
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-rabbitmq
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-minio:
    image: minio/minio:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-minio
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: "server /data"
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: opencti
